boundary: tenant ownership on a record read
scope: Synthetic owned lab; both accounts and both records are controlled by the evaluator.
hypothesis: Tenant A can read Tenant B's controlled record without sharing.

artifacts.observation: Fixture manifest assigns record R-B and value CANARY-B to Tenant B only; no share exists.
Tenant A reads its own R-A record and receives CANARY-A.
With Tenant A's session, a read of R-B returns CANARY-B and identifies R-B as the response object; the same result repeats after an equivalent reset.
With Tenant A's session, a nonexistent record returns 404; a different Tenant A account also reads R-B only when intentionally shared.
